items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D1 | Launch sign-in is email OTP through Resend | Phone OTP after launch, once a provider is chosen. Test login exists only in development and staging, and is blocked in production by configuration |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D2 | Recruiter job posting is in launch | Employer verification and authorization are required before posting |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D3 | Referrals stay off at launch | Activated only where verified referrers exist. Until then, the candidate sees an informative empty state, not a broken feature |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D4 | Candidate-to-recruiter email launches with small caps | Tested abuse controls required. Caps raised only after measured delivery and abuse data |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D5 | Manual official-link application is the baseline | The browser helper is an optional enhancement |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D6 | Email is the mandatory verification tick | College, profile-link, and other ticks are optional, based on segment |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D7 | Date of birth is an age-screening measure | It is not proof of adulthood. Only the screening result is retained |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D8 | Interview organizer is launch-core | Part of the launch definition, not optional |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D9 | Candidate outreach is sent by CareerScope | Candidate's name is in the message and reply-to. Sending domain is careerscope.tech |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D10 | Public job pages publish full text only where source rights permit | Otherwise they link out with attribution |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D11 | Second email provider for sign-in fallback | Configured before launch behind a provider switch flag. Own SPF, DKIM, and DMARC setup |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D12 | Recovery point for application records: 1 hour | Continuous WAL archiving to an off-host store, confirmed by restore drill. If archiving is not ready by launch, the 24-hour fallback applies and candidates are told to re-check records after a restore |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D13 | Listing thresholds set from measurement | Not fixed in this document. Measured on approved sources before public discovery opens |

items.heading: Approved decisions
items.text: | D14 | Launch source set | Recruiter postings, ATS public boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable), and candidate-supplied links. Other sources added only after terms and coverage checks. Naukri and Indeed stay gated |

items.text: - Kill switch stops AI, email, and sync

items.heading: Testing
items.context: Acceptance tests that must pass before launch:
items.text: - Referrals show empty state while off

items.heading: Testing
items.context: Acceptance tests that must pass before launch:
items.text: - Platform failure tests pass individually for Redis, PostgreSQL, email provider, and workers, including recovery and data consistency

items.heading: Testing
items.context: Acceptance tests that must pass before launch:
items.text: - Restore drill meets the 1-hour recovery point and 4-hour recovery time targets, or the 24-hour fallback is in effect and disclosed internally

items.heading: Testing
items.context: Acceptance tests that must pass before launch:
items.text: When referrals are activated, the referral acceptance tests in v10 section 16 must also pass.

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Uptime, errors (Sentry or equivalent), structured JSON logs, traces, metrics

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Every log line: request ID, hashed user ID, route, duration; redaction for resumes, emails, phone numbers, tokens

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Request ID shown to users in errors

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Debug by request ID, hashed user, or feature

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Dashboards: operations, cost, product funnel, business

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Alerts: downtime, error spikes, sync failures, AI spend, bounce rate, failed jobs, sign-in outage

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Alert delivery independent of the primary VPS

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Analytics: no personal data; consent for non-essential tracking

items.heading: Monitoring, analytics, and logs
items.text: - Retention: 30 days detailed logs, 90 days summaries, audit logs as required

items.heading: Data safety
items.text: - Portal data stored: link, title, company only

items.heading: Data safety
items.text: - Listing bodies from portals not stored, cached, or logged

items.heading: Data safety
items.text: - No user or portal content used for AI training without explicit opt-in

items.heading: Data safety
items.text: - AI provider no-training settings verified and recorded

items.heading: Data safety
items.text: - Minimal data sent to AI; untrusted text (job descriptions, resumes, messages) tested for prompt injection

items.heading: Data safety
items.text: - Deletion timelines per data class: primary database, file storage, caches, search, logs, third-party processors, and backups. Legal retention exceptions listed

items.heading: Data safety
items.text: - Staff see masked personal data; unmasking logged with reason

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Privacy policy and terms naming Viswatra

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Grievance officer (DPDP Act)

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - DPDP implementation matrix: legal basis, notices, consent withdrawal, grievance, retention, processors, breach procedure

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Commencement dates confirmed against the official MeitY notification before any date is stated publicly

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Cross-border transfers to AI and model providers disclosed

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - AI disclosure wherever AI output appears, with a contest path

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Outreach email rules published, with abuse reporting

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Age screen disclosure; under-18 accounts not created

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Recruiter terms: posting, outreach, data use

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Photo and verification consent flows reviewed by counsel

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Verification evidence and recheck rules reviewed by counsel

items.heading: Legal and trust
items.text: - Recruiter pricing and refund terms published before any paid plan

items.heading: Post-launch and gated
items.text: Post-launch: phone OTP; mobile push and mobile apps; SMS; skill verification; employer-confirmed tick; identity verification (gated on eKYC); recruiter search, shortlists, pipeline, analytics; talent pools; career transition planner; offer decision workspace; portfolio showcase; job market experimentation; in-app code execution; AI mock interviews; XP, quests, and streaks; courses beyond external links; alumni mentors; email auto-tracking; voice input.

items.heading: Post-launch and gated
items.text: Gated on external approval: WhatsApp (Meta); Indeed and Naukri ingestion (partner or terms); eKYC contract; licensed job-data providers.

items.heading: Post-launch and gated
items.text: Never: LinkedIn ingestion or form fill; automated submission; stored employer credentials; scraping recruiter contacts from sites or portals; pay-to-rank.

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Sources: permission profile recorded for each enabled source; coverage thresholds set from measured data; stale and duplicate rates measured on a golden set

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Candidate loop: first match, first application, and completion measured with test accounts

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Evidence: apply method and confirmations stored correctly

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Verification: ticks, expiry, and revocation tested

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - AI: factuality, prompt-injection, quota, and fallback tests pass

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Data protection: isolation, deletion, restore drill, consent withdrawal, incident procedure

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Sign-in: both email providers tested; outage state tested

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Session security: rotation and reuse detection tested

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Outreach: caps, disclosure, reply-to, abuse controls tested

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Recruiters: employer verification and posting authorization tested

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Operations: failure domain plan, recovery targets, degraded modes, and platform failure tests pass

items.heading: Acceptance gates before launch
items.text: - Launch controls: test login blocked in production; kill switch working; feature flags verified in production; alerts reach the owner independently of the primary VPS

items.heading: Go/no-go checklist
items.text: Each row needs evidence, an owner, a result (pass, fail, or waived with reason), and a blocking severity. Launch requires zero open critical items, and every high item either passed or explicitly waived by the owner in writing.
